pidSettings.pidLoopTime_tooltip: The time in seconds of the PID calculations and relay control loop. Since water heating is a slow process this also works best when slow ex. 30-60sec
pidSettings.stepInterval_tooltip: The time between steps less means more substeps will be added
pidSettings.kP_tooltip: Proportional gain. Direct power response to current temperature error. Recommended: 20.0 - 30.0
pidSettings.kI_tooltip: Integral gain (scaled down internally). Corrects long-term steady-state errors. Recommended: 1.0 - 2.5
pidSettings.kD_tooltip: Derivative gain (scaled up internally). Predictive brake to prevent overshoots based on heating speed. Recommended: 30.0 - 50.0
pidSettings.kP_boiltooltip: Proportional gain. Direct power response to current temperature error. Recommended for boil: 20.0 - 30.0
pidSettings.kI_boiltooltip: Integral gain (scaled down internally). Corrects long-term steady-state errors. Recommended for boil: 3 - 5
pidSettings.kD_boiltooltip: Derivative gain (scaled up internally). Predictive brake to prevent overshoots based on heating speed. Recommended for boil: 0
pidSettings.delta_tooltip: The maximum allowed temperature band above setpoint used for weighted peak tracking to avoid overheating. Recommended: 1.0 - 2.0
pidSettings.pidLoopTime_tooltip: The duration of one PID calculation cycle in seconds.
pidSettings.boost_until_tooltip:
Ignore PID until this % is reached, then wait for temp drop and restart PID.
Boost must also be set at schedule step
Set to 0 to disable)
pidSettings.heater_limit_tooltip: Limits PID controlled heater power at this %. Boost overrides this limit
pidSettings.relay_guard_tooltip: Minimum On/Off state time for relays to avoid useless short glitches, in seconds
